name: OneXR VR
summary:
Organizations across the world, especially the manufacturing companies, experience difficulty in obtaining expertise for selling & marketing machines digitally, and have to depend on traditional methods of marketing, which result in millions of dollars.

OneXR - VR application enables virtual delivery of contents related to your products for the prospects to help them during the pre-purchase stage, which can work on Oculus VR headset devices. It elevates the level of service a user receives without worrying
